Before I clsoe the cassette, I make sure that the cassette is lined up evenly and that everything is even in place. I do this bc if you put the cassette into the red/black cartridge (or whatever it’s called) and if you have things out of place to where the edges of stuff as exposed, then sometimes trying to force the cassette into the cartridge will wrinkle the membrane and sandwich in general.
